literal: The interrogation found no sign of rebellion; because Wenshu had fled, he was sentenced to death in absentia.
idiomatic: The interrogation found no sign of rebellion; because Wenshu had fled, he was sentenced to death in absentia.

literal: Yi was placed in a separate lodge west of the palace and guarded by forbidden troops.
idiomatic: Yi was placed in a separate lodge west of the palace and guarded by forbidden troops.

literal: Wei should have suffered the penalty for false accusation; Cha spoke to the Empress Dowager, wishing to open the way for future informers, and Wei was demoted to Administrator of Changping commandery in Yanzhou and Ji to Magistrate of Daqiang in Qinzhou.
idiomatic: Wei should have suffered the penalty for false accusation; Cha spoke to the Empress Dowager, wishing to open the way for future informers, and Wei was demoted to Administrator of Changping in Yanzhou and Ji to Magistrate of Daqiang in Qinzhou.

literal: Wei and Ji were both versed in the classics and histories, yet frivolous and without conduct;
idiomatic: Wei and Ji were both versed in the classics and histories, yet frivolous and without conduct;

literal: Yi's honored kin and lofty reputation were looked to by court and countryside.
idiomatic: Yi's honored kin and lofty reputation were looked to by court and countryside.

literal: Wei received Yi's favor and reward yet shamelessly sowed discord; men of learning throughout the realm all marveled and despised him.
idiomatic: Wei received Yi's favor and reward yet shamelessly sowed discord; scholars throughout the realm all marveled and despised him.

literal: When Cha killed Yi and monopolized court government, because the Wei brothers had earlier denounced Yi, Wei was summoned as Regular Palace Attendant and Ji as Erudite of the Imperial Academy and concurrent Attending Censor.
idiomatic: When Cha killed Yi and monopolized court government, because the Wei brothers had earlier denounced Yi, Wei was summoned as Regular Palace Attendant and Ji as Erudite of the Imperial Academy and concurrent Attending Censor.

literal: Cha was very intimate with them.
idiomatic: Cha was very intimate with them.

literal: Wei was promoted over rank to Direct Transmission Regular Attendant and also made Governor of Luozhou.
idiomatic: Wei was promoted over rank to Direct Transmission Regular Attendant and also made Governor of Luozhou.

literal: Ji was promoted over rank to Secretariat Gentleman.
idiomatic: Ji was promoted over rank to Secretariat Gentleman.

literal: Ji, style Zhonglie.
idiomatic: Ji, whose style was Zhonglie.

literal: Earlier Bian had told his clansman cousin Shijing that "Wei is careless and dangerous while Ji's insight is insufficient—they will surely ruin my house."
idiomatic: Earlier Bian had told his clansman cousin Shijing that "Wei is careless and dangerous while Ji's insight is insufficient—they will surely ruin my house."

literal: Shijing did not think so.
idiomatic: Shijing did not think so.

literal: By then it proved true.
idiomatic: By then it proved true.

literal: Hearers said none knows a son like the father.
idiomatic: Hearers said none knows a son like the father.

literal: Director of the Secretariat Li Chong, Left Vice-Director Guo Zuo, and Right Vice-Director You Zhao often said: "Boxu is vicious and careless; in the end he will ruin the Song house—lucky if he dies first."
idiomatic: Director Li Chong, Left Vice-Director Guo Zuo, and Right Vice-Director You Zhao often said: "Boxu is vicious and careless; in the end he will ruin the Song house—lucky if he dies first."

literal: Discussants held there were signs of it.
idiomatic: Discussants held there were signs of it.

literal: Later he was made Governor of Yingzhou.
idiomatic: Later he was made Governor of Yingzhou.

literal: When Empress Dowager Ling restored the government she stripped Cha's faction of their names and Wei returned home.
idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Ling restored the government she stripped Cha's faction of their names and Wei returned home.

literal: Soon his earlier false accusation against Prince of Qinghe was pursued; he was granted death by edict at Ye.
idiomatic: Soon his earlier false accusation against Prince of Qinghe was pursued; he was granted death by edict at Ye.

literal: His son Chunqing died young; his younger brother Ji made his second son Qinren heir.
idiomatic: His son Chunqing died young; his younger brother Ji made his second son Qinren heir.

literal: Qinren, at the end of Wuding, was Libationer of the Grand Commandant.
idiomatic: Qinren, at the end of Wuding, was Libationer of the Grand Commandant.

literal: Ji, at the end of Emperor Ming's reign, was Northern-route Mobile Vice-Director and died at Jinyang.
idiomatic: Ji, at the end of Emperor Ming's reign, was Northern-route Mobile Vice-Director and died at Jinyang.

literal: His son Qindao.
idiomatic: His son Qindao.

literal: Qindao served Qi and rose to Governor of Zhongshan.
idiomatic: Qindao served Qi and rose to Governor of Zhongshan.

literal: He was skilled at winning people, yet loved to scrutinize small matters.
idiomatic: He was skilled at winning people, yet loved to scrutinize small matters.

literal: The clerks and aides of his prefecture and office sent out as spies among the people had to be paid first before they dared eat.
idiomatic: The clerks and aides of his prefecture and office sent out as spies among the people had to be paid first before they dared eat.

literal: When he arrived to take office he was called strict and orderly.
idiomatic: When he arrived to take office he was called strict and orderly.

literal: Soon he was summoned as Vice-Director of the Yellow Gate and also ordered to teach the crown prince administrative affairs in the Eastern Palace.
idiomatic: Soon he was summoned as Vice-Director of the Yellow Gate and also ordered to teach the crown prince administrative affairs in the Eastern Palace.

literal: At that time Zheng Zimo was known for literary learning and also received intimate favor.
idiomatic: At that time Zheng Zimo was known for literary learning and also received intimate favor.

literal: Qindao had originally been a clerk versed in law and did not know antiquity well; whenever he had doubts he always consulted Zimo.
idiomatic: Qindao had originally been a clerk versed in law and did not know antiquity well; whenever he had doubts he always consulted Zimo.

literal: The two were favored in both palaces; even princes and honored ministers did not dare fail to respect them.
idiomatic: The two were favored in both palaces; even princes and honored ministers did not dare fail to respect them.

literal: Qindao was again made Director of the Secretariat, still with concurrent Vice-Directorship of the Yellow Gate.
idiomatic: Qindao was again made Director of the Secretariat, still with concurrent Vice-Directorship of the Yellow Gate.

literal: At the beginning of Qianming he was made Attendant and was executed together with Yang Yin.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Qianming he was made Attendant and was executed together with Yang Yin.

literal: He was posthumously made Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Governor of Zhao.
idiomatic: He was posthumously made Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Governor of Zhao.

literal: Bian's clansman cousin Ying, style Wenxian, held the post of Governor of Wei commandery.
idiomatic: Bian's clansman cousin Ying, style Wenxian, held the post of Governor of Wei commandery.

literal: He bribed Liu Teng; Teng spoke for him and he was made Governor of Liangzhou.
idiomatic: He bribed Liu Teng; Teng spoke for him and he was made Governor of Liangzhou.

literal: Fifteen years after Ying's former wife the Liu clan died, Ying dreamed he saw her.
idiomatic: Fifteen years after Ying's former wife the Liu clan died, Ying dreamed he saw her.

literal: She bowed and said: "Your new wife has now been assigned as wife to Gao Chong; I have come to take leave of you."
idiomatic: She bowed and said: "Your new wife has now been assigned as wife to Gao Chong; I have come to take leave of you."

literal: Tears streamed down.
idiomatic: Tears streamed down.

literal: Ying soon saw Chong and told him.
idiomatic: Ying soon saw Chong and told him.

literal: Chong died several days later.
idiomatic: Chong died several days later.

literal: Ying's clansman cousin Honggui was a staff member of the Pacify-the-North Headquarters in Dingzhou.
idiomatic: Ying's clansman cousin Honggui was a staff member of the Pacify-the-North Headquarters in Dingzhou.

literal: Escorting garrison soldiers to Jingzhou, he took four hundred bolts of silk from the soldiers; when the soldiers were about to report him, he beheaded ten soldiers.
idiomatic: Escorting garrison soldiers to Jingzhou, he took four hundred bolts of silk from the soldiers; when the soldiers were about to report him, he beheaded ten soldiers.

literal: He also was crude and did not understand the visible order; the law provided the penalty of exposing the head, yet he cut off the soldiers' hands alive, poured water on them, and then beheaded them.
idiomatic: He also was crude and did not understand the visible order; the law provided the penalty of exposing the head, yet he cut off the soldiers' hands alive, poured water on them, and then beheaded them.

literal: Before long he suffered execution by law.
idiomatic: Before long he suffered execution by law.

literal: People pitied the soldiers' suffering and laughed at Honggui's folly.
idiomatic: People pitied the soldiers' suffering and laughed at Honggui's folly.

literal: Bian's clansman cousin Fan.
idiomatic: Bian's clansman cousin Fan.

literal: Fan, style Feiwu, from youth had conduct and integrity; the world expected firmness of him.
idiomatic: Fan, style Feiwu, from youth had conduct and integrity; the world expected firmness of him.

literal: In Emperor Xiaozhuang's time he was made Left Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Education and Governor of Henan.
idiomatic: In Emperor Xiaozhuang's time he was made Left Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Education and Governor of Henan.

literal: Earlier, when Fan was Magistrate of Heyin, a slave of Princess Shunyang's household committed robbery and was seized but not sent up.
idiomatic: Earlier, when Fan was Magistrate of Heyin, a slave of Princess Shunyang's household committed robbery and was seized but not sent up.

literal: Fan led troops to surround the princess's residence, seized her son-in-law Feng Mu, and drove him on foot to the county seat.
idiomatic: Fan led troops to surround the princess's residence, seized her son-in-law Feng Mu, and drove him on foot to the county seat.

literal: It was the height of summer; he was made to stand in the midday sun until sweat soaked the ground.
idiomatic: It was the height of summer; he was made to stand in the midday sun until sweat soaked the ground.

literal: The county had long had a great cangue that people called "Mawei Green."
idiomatic: The county had long had a great cangue that people called "Mawei Green."

literal: When Fan became magistrate the chief clerk asked to burn it.
idiomatic: When Fan became magistrate the chief clerk asked to burn it.

literal: Fan said: "Set it by the south wall to await the powerful."
idiomatic: Fan said: "Set it by the south wall to await the powerful."

literal: Before long an inner attendant, Yang Xiaoju, came to the county on business with insolent words; Fan ordered Mawei Green taken to lock him.
idiomatic: Before long an inner attendant, Yang Xiaoju, came to the county on business with insolent words; Fan ordered Mawei Green taken to lock him.

literal: When Xiaoju was released he entered a complaint to Emperor Xuanwu.
idiomatic: When Xiaoju was released he entered a complaint to Emperor Xuanwu.

literal: Emperor Xuanwu was greatly angered and ordered the Governor of Henan to investigate; Fan stated the facts in full.
idiomatic: Emperor Xuanwu was greatly angered and ordered the Governor of Henan to investigate; Fan stated the facts in full.

literal: The edict said: "You deliberately violated court law—did you not wish to make a display to buy a name?"
idiomatic: The edict said: "You deliberately violated court law—did you not wish to make a display to buy a name?"

literal: Fan replied: "The one who made it was not I; the one who buys a name should also not be I.
idiomatic: Fan replied: "The one who made it was not I; the one who buys a name should also not be I.

literal: The reason I kept it was not that I dared use it on the common people—I wished to await violent fellows like Xiaoju."
idiomatic: The reason I kept it was not that I dared use it on the common people—I wished to await violent fellows like Xiaoju."

literal: Thereupon his authority shook the capital.
idiomatic: Thereupon his authority shook the capital.

literal: When he reached Luoyang and then served as Governor of Henan, he feared and deferred to power, and received one another in turn; therefore his reputation in his day was greatly diminished.
idiomatic: When he reached Luoyang and then served as Governor of Henan, he feared and deferred to power, and received one another in turn; therefore his reputation in his day was greatly diminished.

literal: He died in office and was posthumously made Attendant, Guard General, and Governor of Xiangzhou.
idiomatic: He died in office and was posthumously made Attendant, Guard General, and Governor of Xiangzhou.

literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was again posthumously made General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat, and Governor of Yongzhou; his posthumous title was Zhenlie.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was again posthumously made General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Left Vice-Director of the Secretariat, and Governor of Yongzhou; his posthumous title was Zhenlie.

literal: Fan's younger brother Yu: style Daohe, sincere and resolute with will and conduct.
idiomatic: Fan's younger brother Yu: style Daohe, sincere and resolute with will and conduct.

literal: He died as Grand Master of Palace Service.
idiomatic: He died as Grand Master of Palace Service.

literal: His son Shiliang.
idiomatic: His son Shiliang.

literal: Shiliang, style Yuanyou.
idiomatic: Shiliang, whose style was Yuanyou.

literal: At fifteen he already had courage.
idiomatic: At fifteen he already had courage.

literal: Later he followed his uncle Fan in Southern Yanzhou and repeatedly won merit in battle.
idiomatic: Later he followed his uncle Fan in Southern Yanzhou and repeatedly won merit in battle.

literal: Mobile Vice-Director Prince of Huaiyang Yu spoke with him and was struck by him.
idiomatic: Mobile Vice-Director Prince of Huaiyang Yu spoke with him and was struck by him.

literal: The Wei court, because Erzhu Rong showed signs of disloyalty, planned against him; the emperor secretly ordered Yu to lead troops to Luoyang.
idiomatic: The Wei court, because Erzhu Rong showed signs of disloyalty, planned against him; the emperor secretly ordered Yu to lead troops to Luoyang.

literal: Yu was at Liang commandery and claimed illness; he lent Shiliang his commandant's seal and ordered him to return to Southern Yanzhou to raise troops to meet the deadline.
idiomatic: Yu was at Liang commandery and claimed illness; he lent Shiliang his commandant's seal and ordered him to return to Southern Yanzhou to raise troops to meet the deadline.

literal: Shiliang asked to select three thousand cavalry from the visible troops and reach Luoyang in five days, and set forth three stratagems; Yu could follow none of them.
idiomatic: Shiliang asked to select three thousand cavalry from the visible troops and reach Luoyang in five days, and set forth three stratagems; Yu could follow none of them.

literal: Soon he was made Attending Censor in the Palace and went to Hebei to register households, capturing many hidden and idle persons.
idiomatic: Soon he was made Attending Censor in the Palace and went to Hebei to register households, capturing many hidden and idle persons.

literal: On his return he saw many bones beside Jijun city and sent letters to the commanderies and prefectures ordering them all collected and buried.
idiomatic: On his return he saw many bones beside Jijun city and sent letters to the commanderies and prefectures ordering them all collected and buried.

literal: That night sweet rain poured in torrents.
idiomatic: That night sweet rain poured in torrents.

literal: Governor of Henei Tian Gu had taken bribes of a million cash; Shiliang investigated but did not finish before an amnesty sent him back.
idiomatic: Governor of Henei Tian Gu had taken bribes of a million cash; Shiliang investigated but did not finish before an amnesty sent him back.

literal: Emperor Xiaozhuang comforted him saying: "I know the households you registered were double the original rolls.
idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozhuang comforted him saying: "I know the households you registered were double the original rolls.

literal: If every official used his mind like this, it would be as if another realm had appeared under heaven."
idiomatic: If every official used his mind like this, it would be as if another realm had appeared under heaven."

literal: Afterward he was transferred within the Palace.
idiomatic: Afterward he was transferred within the Palace.

literal: Shiliang memorialized that the Palace chief handled banquet affairs and asked that it be transferred to another office.
idiomatic: Shiliang memorialized that the Palace chief handled banquet affairs and asked that it be transferred to another office.

literal: The emperor said: "Do you dislike working the kitchen yourself?
idiomatic: The emperor said: "Do you dislike working the kitchen yourself?

literal: Give it to the Right Military Office and make that the permanent rule."
idiomatic: Give it to the Right Military Office and make that the permanent rule."

literal: Governor of Hezhou Liang Jingrui, a Qiang chieftain of Fuhan, relied on distance and was disrespectful; his New Year envoys for years claimed illness.
idiomatic: Governor of Hezhou Liang Jingrui, a Qiang chieftain of Fuhan, relied on distance and was disrespectful; his New Year envoys for years claimed illness.

literal: Governor of Qinzhou Hou Mo Chen Yue accepted his bribes and often forwarded his memorials.
idiomatic: Governor of Qinzhou Hou Mo Chen Yue accepted his bribes and often forwarded his memorials.

literal: Shiliang memorialized to convict them both.
idiomatic: Shiliang memorialized to convict them both.

literal: The emperor praised him and said to Zhangsun Yongye: "Director Song truly has the family style—very much to be valued."
idiomatic: The emperor praised him and said to Zhangsun Yongye: "Director Song truly has the family style—very much to be valued."

literal: Later he was made Governor of Qinghe.
idiomatic: Later he was made Governor of Qinghe.

literal: Shiliang's talent and insight were clear and bright; he was especially skilled in the art of government.
idiomatic: Shiliang's talent and insight were clear and bright; he was especially skilled in the art of government.

literal: He had not been long in the commandery when his reputation rose very high.
idiomatic: He had not been long in the commandery when his reputation rose very high.

literal: Yangping commandery forwarded more than thirty robbers for arrest; Shiliang examined the facts and sent only twelve; the rest he released.
idiomatic: Yangping commandery forwarded more than thirty robbers for arrest; Shiliang examined the facts and sent only twelve; the rest he released.

literal: Governor of Yangping Wei Minglang raged: "You casually release my bandits!"
idiomatic: Governor of Yangping Wei Minglang raged: "You casually release my bandits!"

literal: When the case was pushed, those sent were all guilty and those released were all innocent.
idiomatic: When the case was pushed, those sent were all guilty and those released were all innocent.

literal: Minglang was greatly convinced.
idiomatic: Minglang was greatly convinced.

literal: Southeast of the commandery was Qudi, where the Cheng clan of Gong blocked the place and lived; many bandits gathered there.
idiomatic: Southeast of the commandery was Qudi, where the Cheng clan of Gong blocked the place and lived; many bandits gathered there.

literal: People made a saying: "Better cross Dongwu and Kuaiji than pass Cheng Gong's Qudi."
idiomatic: People made a saying: "Better cross Dongwu and Kuaiji than pass Cheng Gong's Qudi."

literal: Shiliang imposed eight regulations; the bandits fled to other regions.
idiomatic: Shiliang imposed eight regulations; the bandits fled to other regions.
